DNS over HTTPS ekola bw'ensi yo bweetonda YouTube. Ssinga YouTube ekimala okuwulira kitundu kyo, laba okukozesa Proxy oba VPN.

Kozesa Proxies zize kuweereza eby'obufunze ez'olina okukkiriza nti za bukakafu. Proxies za buntu zisobola okuba nga zirina obwenkanya naye tezirina bukakafu buli wansi — beera omuwa obugumu. Tetulimba ku bukakafu bwo.
Kozesa DNS over HTTPS (DoH) okulongoosa amannya g'ebifo
Londako IPv4 oba IPv6 ku kuddukanya okuddukanya downloads ne streaming. Ssinga downloads zirina obuzito, leka ku IPv4.

Gyebale ko! Nze nastechresearch, developer wa AmaBeat. Singa AmaBeat yaweerezeddwa mu buli lunaku lwo, osobola kuyamba okukulaakulanya nga tonka okuwa obuyambi oba okussa star ku GitHub. Webale okutuyamba ku ntikko ya app.
